text_block_list.text: The new year. I came for Hatsumode with Smart Falcon. However, she seemed different than usual—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
...Mumble, mumble, mumble.
Mumble, mumble, mumble, mumble...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Ah, did I say that out loud?!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
You're supposed to make your wish silently in your heart.
Come on, put your hands together too, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
...
Nighty-night~

Looking at her profile as she pressed her hands together in prayer,
I could sense an extraordinary determination...

Moved by her seriousness,
the wish I came up with for this year is...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: —Alright-y☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: —Alright-y☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: —Alright-y☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Now that our wishes are all set,
shall we go take care of the next thing on our schedule?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: We need to talk... about your Senior Year.

I had a rough plan laid out for
how to proceed with Smart Falcon in the Senior Year.
choice_data_list: Let's deliver the results expected of us, just like this.

text_block_list.text: She achieved remarkable results in her Classic Year. I told her that first, we should win the February Stakes and keep steadily moving forward in the Senior Year too.
However—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
No, that won't do.
Predictable and steady just isn't good enough!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: "Because if I just keep going as normal, I won't be able to climb any higher than this..."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: That's why—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Falco's gonna take 1st place in all
of her Senior Year goal races!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
And not just safe, easy races either.
I'm gonna win them all in GⅠ races!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
First is the February Stakes.
Then the Teio Sho, the JBC Classic,
and the Champions Cup...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: And then, year-end's Tokyo Daishoten!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I want to declare to everyone
that I'm going to win every single one!

Of course, the plan was always to take on the races
Smart Falcon suggested, and to aim for 1st place in every single one. But...
choice_data_list: Why do you want to make that declaration?

text_block_list.text:
Although she continually aimed for center stage, she didn't seem overly obsessed with victory itself.
Naturally, there had to be a reason.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
It's to let everyone know.
That there's an amazing Umadol on dirt...!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
You've been promoting dirt racing using orthodox methods
up until now, right?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: But... if that's the case, then last year's Tokyo Daishoten showed me that that level of excitement was the limit.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
So, if you're aiming even higher—
if you're aiming for a stage like the Arima Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I gotta grab way, way more attention.
I have to become an even more amazing Falco!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
For example—yes, just like that Silence Suzuka,
who was hailed as "from another dimension"!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
...! They're incredible after all.
Falco's definitely gonna be like that too...!
Come to think of it, she had always projected her ideal Umadol onto Silence Suzuka.

Running flat-out down an open track,
captivating people with overwhelming speed.
I've struggled all this time just to reach that dream.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Overwhelmingly! Thoroughly!
Transcending both turf and dirt, Falco will be number one!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: So I need you to brace yourself too, Trainer! Brace yourself to stand on the edge of the cliff with Falco...!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Let's reach the true top with Falco!
Let's whip up a Falco whirlwind!

Taking 1st place in every GⅠ packed with top contenders.
Once you declare something like that, there's no turning back.
"Still, ever since she and I dreamed of becoming the top umadol on dirt... my mind has already been made up!"
choice_data_list: I'm gonna stir up a storm!
I'm gonna stir up a storm!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: —Right!!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Smartly taking 1st place in everything"!
I'll definitely make this year's resolution come true!
